multiple-imputation.data_shape: 示例独立模拟240名参与者：一列连续结果 y 有缺失，一列预测变量 x 全观测。只演示单目标正态贝叶斯插补和均值的 Rubin 合并，不是通用多变量插补程序。
multiple-imputation.example_code:
# One incomplete continuous outcome; fully observed predictor.
set.seed(20261001)
n <- 240L
x <- rnorm(n)
y_complete <- 50 + 5 * x + rnorm(n, sd = 8)
missing <- runif(n) < plogis(-1 + 0.7 * x)
y <- y_complete
y[missing] <- NA_real_
observed <- !is.na(y)
stopifnot(all(is.finite(x)), sum(observed) > 3L, any(missing))
fit <- lm(y ~ x, subset = observed)
x_obs <- model.matrix(fit)
x_mis <- cbind(1, x[missing])
df_res <- df.residual(fit)
stopifnot(qr(x_obs)$rank == ncol(x_obs), df_res > 0)
rss <- sum(residuals(fit)^2)
stopifnot(rss > 0)
v_beta <- solve(crossprod(x_obs))
beta_hat <- coef(fit)
m <- 40L
q <- u <- numeric(m)
completed <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = n, ncol = m)
for (j in seq_len(m)) {
  # Posterior variance and coefficients, then predictive residual noise.
  sigma2 <- rss / rchisq(1, df = df_res)
  beta <- beta_hat + sqrt(sigma2) *
    drop(t(chol(v_beta)) %*% rnorm(length(beta_hat)))
  y_j <- y
  y_j[missing] <- drop(x_mis %*% beta) +
    rnorm(sum(missing), sd = sqrt(sigma2))
  completed[, j] <- y_j
  q[j] <- mean(y_j)
  u[j] <- var(y_j) / n
}
stopifnot(all(is.finite(completed)))
stopifnot(all(completed[observed, 1] == y[observed]))
q_bar <- mean(q)
u_bar <- mean(u)
between <- var(q)
total <- u_bar + (1 + 1 / m) * between
# Rubin large-complete-sample degrees-of-freedom approximation.
df_pool <- if (between > 0) {
  (m - 1) * (1 + u_bar / ((1 + 1 / m) * between))^2
} else Inf
ci <- q_bar + c(-1, 1) * qt(0.975, df_pool) * sqrt(total)
result <- c(n = n, missing_n = sum(missing), m = m,
  complete_case_mean = mean(y, na.rm = TRUE), pooled_mean = q_bar,
  within_variance = u_bar, between_variance = between,
  total_variance = total, pooled_se = sqrt(total),
  ci_low = ci[1], ci_high = ci[2], df_pool = df_pool)
print(round(result, 4))
stopifnot(total >= u_bar, between > 0, ci[1] < q_bar, ci[2] > q_bar)

standardization.data_shape: cross_sectional_survey.csv 一行一名参与者；示例对 stress 数值列划分训练与测试参照。
standardization.example_code:
# Learn the scaling reference on training rows only.
data_file <- if (file.exists("cross_sectional_survey.csv")) {
  "cross_sectional_survey.csv"
} else file.path("examples", "data", "cross_sectional_survey.csv")
d <- read.csv(data_file, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
stopifnot(is.numeric(d$stress), all(is.finite(d$stress)))
set.seed(20261001)
train <- sample(seq_len(nrow(d)), floor(0.8 * nrow(d)))
test <- setdiff(seq_len(nrow(d)), train)
reference_mean <- mean(d$stress[train])
reference_sd <- sd(d$stress[train])
stopifnot(is.finite(reference_sd), reference_sd > 0)
d$stress_z <- (d$stress - reference_mean) / reference_sd
result <- c(train_n = length(train), test_n = length(test),
  reference_mean = reference_mean, reference_sd = reference_sd,
  train_z_mean = mean(d$stress_z[train]),
  train_z_sd = sd(d$stress_z[train]),
  test_z_mean = mean(d$stress_z[test]),
  test_z_sd = sd(d$stress_z[test]))
print(round(result, 4))
stopifnot(abs(mean(d$stress_z[train])) < 1e-10,
  abs(sd(d$stress_z[train]) - 1) < 1e-10)

对常数列除以零。

centering.data_shape: cross_sectional_survey.csv 一行一名参与者；social_support 为预测变量，stress 为结果。示例用全样本支持均值作零点。
centering.example_code:
# Compare equivalent intercept-and-slope parameterizations.
data_file <- if (file.exists("cross_sectional_survey.csv")) {
  "cross_sectional_survey.csv"
} else file.path("examples", "data", "cross_sectional_survey.csv")
d <- read.csv(data_file, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
stopifnot(all(is.finite(d$social_support)), all(is.finite(d$stress)))
reference <- mean(d$social_support)
d$support_c <- d$social_support - reference
raw_fit <- lm(stress ~ social_support, data = d)
centered_fit <- lm(stress ~ support_c, data = d)
max_fit_difference <- max(abs(fitted(raw_fit) - fitted(centered_fit)))
result <- c(reference = reference, centered_mean = mean(d$support_c),
  raw_sd = sd(d$social_support), centered_sd = sd(d$support_c),
  raw_intercept = unname(coef(raw_fit)[1]),
  centered_intercept = unname(coef(centered_fit)[1]),
  raw_slope = unname(coef(raw_fit)[2]),
  centered_slope = unname(coef(centered_fit)[2]),
  max_fit_difference = max_fit_difference)
print(round(result, 6))
stopifnot(max_fit_difference < 1e-8,
  abs(sd(d$social_support) - sd(d$support_c)) < 1e-10)

mahalanobis-distance.data_shape: cross_sectional_survey.csv 一行一名参与者；用 social_support、stress、well_being 的联合数值模式计算平方马氏距离。
mahalanobis-distance.example_code:
# Classical sample-based squared Mahalanobis distances: exploratory only.
data_file <- if (file.exists("cross_sectional_survey.csv")) {
  "cross_sectional_survey.csv"
} else file.path("examples", "data", "cross_sectional_survey.csv")
d <- read.csv(data_file, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
vars <- c("social_support", "stress", "well_being")
stopifnot(all(vars %in% names(d)))
stopifnot(all(vapply(d[vars], is.numeric, logical(1))))
keep <- complete.cases(d[vars])
x <- as.matrix(d[keep, vars])
stopifnot(all(is.finite(x)), nrow(x) > ncol(x) + 1L)
center <- colMeans(x)
covariance <- cov(x)
stopifnot(qr(covariance)$rank == ncol(x), rcond(covariance) > 1e-10)
d_squared <- mahalanobis(x, center = center, cov = covariance)
# Chi-square reference is approximate with estimated parameters; not a formal test.
cutoff <- qchisq(1 - 0.01 / nrow(x), df = ncol(x))
flag <- d_squared > cutoff
result <- data.frame(id = d$id[keep], d_squared = d_squared, flag = flag)
print(c(complete_n = nrow(x), dimensions = ncol(x),
  cutoff = cutoff, maximum_d_squared = max(d_squared), flagged_n = sum(flag)))
print(head(result[order(result$d_squared, decreasing = TRUE), ], 5))
stopifnot(all(is.finite(d_squared)), all(d_squared >= 0))

d <- read.csv("your_data.csv")
vars <- c("score_1", "score_2", "score_3")
stopifnot(all(vars %in% names(d)))
stopifnot(all(vapply(d[vars], is.numeric, logical(1))))
keep <- complete.cases(d[vars])
x <- as.matrix(d[keep, vars])
stopifnot(all(is.finite(x)), nrow(x) > ncol(x) + 1L)
s <- cov(x)
stopifnot(qr(s)$rank == ncol(x), rcond(s) > 1e-10)
d_squared <- mahalanobis(x, colMeans(x), s)
review <- data.frame(row = which(keep), d_squared = d_squared)
print(head(review[order(review$d_squared, decreasing = TRUE), ], 10))
# Review variable selection, near singularity and distribution assumptions.
# Classical estimates may mask clusters of unusual cases; consider robust methods.
assumption_checks: 使用有共同测量意义的连续指标组合，保留完整行与原始行对应。
协方差须可逆且不能近奇异；冗余变量应先审查。
卡方参考基于联合正态理论，样本内估计中心与协方差后只作近似探索阈值，非精确显著性检验。
经典均值和协方差可能受异常点影响，形成掩蔽；可考虑有依据的稳健诊断。
mahalanobis-distance.interpretation: R mahalanobis 返回平方距离，已考虑变量间协方差。示例用近似卡方参考和保守的多观测阈值作探索标记，不能据此直接删除参与者或声称精确异常概率。即使没有标记，也不能证明数据不存在多变量异常或掩蔽。
mahalanobis-distance.report_template: 报告指标组合、完整样本数、中心与协方差估计方式、平方距离及诊断参考规则，说明标记后的核查与敏感性处理。
common_errors: 把 R 返回的平方距离当未平方距离。
忽略协方差矩阵近奇异。
把探索阈值当精确 p 值。
只凭一个距离阈值自动删除有效罕见观测。
mahalanobis-distance.template_validation_scope: 模板仅作语法解析；真实数据结果需重新执行并检查。
